Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Eligible for the early supported discharge pathway this includes:
       -  Confirmed diagnosis of a new stroke

right.raw_text: -  Able to consent to being in the study

left.raw_text: -  The patient  [AND] and their family/carer agree to rehabilitation process continuing at home

right.raw_text: -  The home environment is conducive to the community-based rehabilitation

left.raw_text: -  Achievable rehabilitation goals can be identified

right.raw_text: -  Document acknowledgement that the patient is sufficiently well enough from a medical perspective to be managed in the community

left.raw_text: -  The patient's language and/or cognitive skills are at a level for them to manage on their own for periods as is necessary

In addition to ESSD criteria participants must;
  -  Have a good grasp of the English language
  -  Have been discharged from the ESSD pathway
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Participants will be excluded if they:
       -  Have any communication difficulties that would prevent them from engaging in the intervention (including hearing impairments, [OR]  visual impairments, inability to understand English)

right.raw_text: These will be assessed at researcher's discretion during baseline assessments

left.raw_text: -  Had a diagnosis of dementia prior to the stroke

right.raw_text: -  Are deemed to lack capacity to give informed consent

left.raw_text: This will be judged via a qualified clinician

right.raw_text:
-  Have had previous experience of CFT
       -  Were receiving medical  [OR] or psychological treatment for a mental illness at the time of their stroke
